summary: Open-WebUI provides a browser-based interface for interacting with large language models. It connects directly to backend providers such as Ollama or the OpenAI API to facilitate text generation and chat functionality.
goodFor: It suits administrators who want a self-hosted graphical interface for local AI models without relying on third-party web services.
watchOut: Running local models requires significant hardware resources, and managing multiple backend integrations can introduce unexpected configuration overhead.
deployNotes: As a containerised application, it typically requires persistent storage for user data and a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
